title: A magnitude 7.8 earthquake struck Nepal with epicenter at Gorkha at a depth of 15.0 km (9.3 mi). In total, at least 10,000 people were killed in Nepal, India, Bangladesh, and China.
text: The April 2015 Nepal earthquake killed 8,962 people and injured 21,952 across the countries of Nepal, India, China and Bangladesh. It occurred at 11:56 Nepal Standard Time on Saturday 25 April 2015, with a magnitude of Mw 7.8–7.9 or Ms 8.1 and a maximum Mercalli Intensity of X (Extreme).

title: A magnitude 7.3 earthquake with the epicenter at Dolakha kills at least 66 people in Nepal.
text: A major earthquake occurred in Nepal on 12 May 2015 at 12:50 pm local time with a moment magnitude of 7.2–7.3, 18 kilometres (11 mi) southeast of Kodari. The epicenter was on the border of Dolakha and Sindhupalchowk, two districts of Nepal.

title: Nepal formally promulgates the Constitution of Nepal through its 2nd Nepalese Constituent Assembly.
text: The Constitution of Nepal the supreme law of Nepal. Nepal is governed according to the Constitution which came into effect on 20 September 2015, replacing the Interim Constitution of 2007.

title: The Indian government blocks vehicles carrying goods towards Nepal through its territory citing insecurity in Nepal's Southern regions which continues for almost six months.
text: Beginning on 23 September 2015, segments of Nepal's Madheshi people imposed a blockage on the country's Indian border as a protest against changes to the country's constitution. Many of Nepal's Madheshi people had migrated to the foothills from the Indian plains, and the Nepalese government accused India of provoking the blockade, which the Indian government denied.

title: K.P. Sharma Oli is elected by the parliament as the Prime Minister of Nepal.
text: Khadga Prasad Sharma Oli better known as K.P. Sharma Oli, is a Nepali politician who served three terms as the prime minister of Nepal, from 2015 to 2016, 2018 to 2021, and 2024 to 2025. He has served as the chairman of the Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist–Leninist) since 2014.

title: Bidhya Devi Bhandari first Nepalese woman President to hold the office.
text: Bidya Devi Bhandari is a Nepali former politician who served as the second president of Nepal from 2015 to 2023. She formerly served as the minister of defence and minister of environment and population.

title: कालो पोथी
text: कालो पोथी मीनबहादुर भामद्वारा निर्देशित र एना केच्को, छिरिङ रितार शेर्पा, मीनबहादुर भाम, देवकी राई, क्याथरिन दुसार्त र अनुप थापाद्वारा निर्मित सन् २०१५ मा प्रदर्शित नेपाली नाट्य चलचित्र हो। मीनबहादुर भामको लेखन रहेको यस चलचित्रमा वेनिशा हमाल, खड्कराज नेपाली र शुक्रराज रोकायाको मुख्य भुमिका रहेको छ। चलचित्रको कथावस्तु नेपाली गृहयुद्ध कालको समयमा सन् २००१ मा उत्तर-पश्चिम नेपालको मुगु जिल्लाको परिदृश्य देखाइएको छ। यो…

title: होस्टेल रिटर्न्स
text: होस्टल रिटर्न्स सन् २०१३ मा रिलिज भएको नेपाली चलचित्र 'होस्टेल' को सिक्वेल हो र यो नेपालका विशिष्ट इन्जिनियरिङ विद्यार्थीको होस्टल जीवनमा आधारित छ। सुरज भुषालको निर्देशन तथा सुनिल रावलको निर्माण रहेको फिल्ममा सुनिल आफैले होस्टल वार्डेनको भूमिका निभाएका छन्। चलचित्रमा सुशील श्रेष्ठ, शशी श्रेष्ठ (सीमा), नाजिर हुसेन (रामेश्वर), स्वस्तिमा खड्का (एलिना) लगायतका युवा कलाकारको अभिनय रहेको छ।

title: कबड्डी कबड्डी
text: नैपाली कथानक चलचित्र कबड्डीको सफलता पछि यसको सिक्वल निर्माण गरिएको चलचित्र हो कबड्डी कबड्डी।यो चलचित्रले राम्रो प्रतिक्रिया र राम्रो बक्स अफिस कलेक्सन गरेको थियो।

title: रेशम फिलिलि
text: रेशम फिलिलि २०७२ वैशाख ११ मा प्रदर्शनमा आएको एक नेपाली कथानक चलचित्र हो। चलचित्रमा विनय श्रेष्ठ, मेनुका प्रधान, कर्मा शाक्य, कामेश्वर चौरासिया, शिशिर वाङ्देल लगायत कलाकारको अभिनय रहेको छ।

title: सेतो बाघ
text: सेतो बाघ एक ऐतिहासिक कथा तथा डायमनसम्शेर राणाको उपन्यास सेतो बाघ उपन्यासमा आधारित चलचित्र हो साथै यो एक नेपाली ऐतिहासिक घटना क्रममा आधारित चलचित्र हो ।

title: अझै पनि
text: अझै पनि सन् २०१५ मा प्रदर्शन भएको एक नेपाली चलचित्र हो। निर्देशक आलोक नेम्बाङको यो अन्तिम चलचित्र हो। चलचित्रमा सुदर्शन थापा र पुजा शर्माको मुख्य भूमिका रहेको छ।

title: Kalo Pothi: The Black Hen
text: Kalo Pothi: The Black Hen is a 2015 drama film directed by Min Bahadur Bham and produced by Anna Katchko, Tsering Rhitar Sherpa, Min Bahadur Bham, Debaki Rai, Catherine Dussart and Anup Thapa. The story takes place in Mugu, a district in north-west Nepal in 2001 during the Nepalese civil war (1996–2006).

title: Hostel Returns
text: Hostel Returns is a sequel to the 2013 Nepali film Hostel and is based on the hostel life of typical engineering students in Nepal. Directed by Suraj Bhusal and produced by Mr Sunil Rawal, Sunil himself plays the role of Hostel Warden in the movie.

title: Kabaddi Kabaddi
text: Kabaddi Kabaddi is a 2015 Nepalese romantic comedy-drama film directed by Ram Babu Gurung, who co-wrote the screenplay with Upendra Subba. The film stars Dayahang Rai, Saugat Malla, Rishma Gurung, Bijay Baral, Buddhi Tamang and Shishir Bangdel.

title: Resham Filili
text: Resham Filili is a Nepali movie which follows the friendship, dreams, hopes and deeds of Resham and Hariya - both whethered by bad luck and misfortunes, must at any cost beat the oddest odds to save their lives from Dorje's men.

title: Seto Bagh
text: Seto Bagh is a 2015 Nepali historical film directed by Neer Shah. The cast includes BS Rana, Rajaram Poudel, Rabi Giri, Shyam Rai and Anjana Kattel.
